decisions.reason: Although it is close to the core offer, the limited public commitment and its disappearance from observation after 2019 make management more likely by 2022 to let this narrower extension go.
This bracket fits the firm's fabrication capabilities and stated broadening of its range, so escalation of commitment and operational fit make continued offering more likely than withdrawal.
As another adjacent support product with a dedicated launch page and strong overlap with existing know-how, it is likely to be retained despite uncertain visibility after launch.

The public waste bin uses some coating and metalworking skills but sits relatively far from the firm's main infrastructure business, so management is more likely to cut this weaker strategic fit once initial commitment fades.

Because this was launched as a broader waste-bin line with several models and visible website commitment, management is likely to persist longer and attribute any weak results to temporary market or tender timing factors.

This ashtray line is also non-core but benefited from visible commitment and multiple models, which under escalation of commitment makes continued offering slightly more likely than stopping it in 2022.
